methods.name: list
methods.summary: Returns the audit history for a flag, newest first.
methods.description:
Returns the audit history for a flag, newest first. Each entry includes the
event type and full flag state after the change; `update` entries include a
field-level diff. Capped at 200 entries per flag.

props.name: account_id
props.description: Cloudflare account ID.

props.name: app_id
props.description: App identifier.

props.name: limit
props.description: Max items to return (1–200).

methods.name: create
methods.description:
Creates a flag. Returns 409 if the key already exists. `type` is inferred from
variation values and may be omitted.

props.name: account_id
props.description: Cloudflare account ID.

props.name: default_variation
props.description:
Variation the API serves when the flag is off, or when it's on but
no rule matches the context. Must be a key in `variations`.

props.name: enabled
props.description:
When false, the flag bypasses all rules and always serves
`default_variation`.

props.name: key
props.description:
Unique identifier for the flag within an app. Used in all evaluation
and SDK calls.

props.name: rules
conditions
props.description:
Conditions the context must satisfy for this rule to match. An empty array
matches all contexts.

props.name: priority
props.description:
Evaluation order: the API evaluates rules with lower numbers first. Must be
unique across the flag's rules.

props.name: serve_variation
props.description: Variation the API serves when this rule matches. Must be a key in `variations`.

Targeting rules evaluated in ascending `priority`; the first
matching rule wins. An empty array means the flag always serves
`default_variation`.

props.name: variations

type.text: { [key: string]: string | number | boolean | { [key: string]: unknown; } | unknown[] | null; }

props.description:
Map of variation name to value. All values share the same type
(boolean, string, number, or JSON object/array), and each serialized value stays
within 10KB.

props.name: type
props.description:
Value type of the flag's variations. The API infers this from the
variation values on write, so you can omit it in requests.

methods.name: update
methods.description:
Replaces the entire flag definition. Omitted fields are dropped, not preserved —
read before writing. Each update appends a changelog entry.

methods.name: list
methods.summary: Lists an app's flags ordered by key.
methods.description:
Lists an app's flags ordered by key. Pass `cursor` from `result_info` to page
forward; a null cursor indicates the last page.

methods.name: delete
methods.description:
Deletes a flag permanently. Subsequent evaluations fall back to the
caller-supplied default. Cannot be undone.

props.description: Cloudflare account ID.

methods.name: get
methods.summary: Evaluates a flag against the provided context.
methods.description:
Evaluates a flag against the provided context. Pass context attributes as query
parameters; values are forwarded as strings. For low-latency in-Worker
evaluation, prefer the Flagship binding over this endpoint.

props.name: account_id
props.description: Cloudflare account ID.

props.name: flagKey
props.description: The flag key to evaluate.

props.name: targetingKey
props.description:
Context targeting key (per OpenFeature spec); used for percentage
rollout bucketing.
